rationale: This role owns Canon's large-format printer product portfolio strategy, including the Colorado M-series, Arizona flatbed printers, and imagePROGRAF lines. They are responsible for product differentiation, competitive positioning, and ensuring Canon's printers deliver on durability and quality promises to customers. Tedlar directly addresses their KPIs: (1) Product differentiation - partnering with Tedlar provides a premium overlaminate recommendation that extends the durability claims Canon makes for UVgel technology and vehicle wrap applications; (2) Customer success metrics - Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan and UV protection reduce warranty claims and customer complaints about fading/cracking on prints from Canon equipment; (3) Market positioning - Canon emphasizes quality and durability (3M MCS Warranty certification, weather-resistant media) and Tedlar enables them to offer customers a complete solution for extreme durability applications. Given Canon's active product launches (Colorado XL-series debut, M-series enhancements) and trade show presence showcasing outdoor/vehicle graphics capabilities, this role would care about specifying protective films that protect Canon's brand reputation for quality and help customers achieve the longest-lasting results.

This role drives revenue growth in Canon's large-format graphics segment and owns customer relationships with sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers - Tedlar's exact target customers. Their priorities align with Tedlar because: (1) Solution selling - Tedlar provides a value-add recommendation that helps Canon sales teams differentiate against competitors (HP, Epson) by offering customers a complete durability solution, not just hardware; (2) Customer retention and expansion - when Canon's customers succeed with longer-lasting graphics protected by Tedlar, it reduces churn and creates upsell opportunities for more Canon equipment; (3) Premium positioning - Tedlar's extreme durability (12-20+ years) and graffiti resistance enable Canon to target higher-margin premium projects (architectural facades, transit graphics, high-end vehicle wraps) where customers will pay more for total cost of ownership reduction. Given Canon's emphasis on outdoor durability, water-resistant media, and harsh condition applications in their Colorado and Arizona marketing, the sales team needs a protective film partner that delivers on these promises and helps close deals where durability is the deciding factor.

This role provides technical support, customer training, and application expertise for Canon's large-format printer customers. They directly handle customer pain points around print durability, outdoor performance issues, and material selection guidance. Tedlar solves their operational challenges: (1) Support ticket reduction - customer complaints about UV fading, cracking, or premature graphic failure on Canon-printed materials decrease when protected with Tedlar's proven 60+ year track record; (2) Technical credibility - Tedlar's extreme temperature range (-70°F to 230°F), mold/mildew resistance, and graffiti resistance provide concrete specifications they can recommend during customer consultations for challenging applications; (3) Application enablement - they can confidently recommend Tedlar for vehicle wraps, architectural graphics, and outdoor signage knowing it will perform for 12-20+ years, protecting Canon's reputation when customers use their Colorado UVgel or Arizona flatbed output. Given Canon's 3M MCS Warranty certification focus and emphasis on durable media offerings, Technical Services needs trusted protective film partners to recommend for applications where customers demand maximum longevity and reduced maintenance costs.
